name: Inchworm Walkout
instructions: Stand tall, hinge forward and place your hands on the floor.
Walk your hands forward until you are in a high plank position.
Walk your feet toward your hands in small steps.
longevityNotes: Mobility is use-it-or-lose-it. Ten minutes of daily joint work preserves the ranges that keep you independent — reaching, bending, and getting up from the floor.
overview: A mobility drill that stretches the hamstrings and challenges the core and shoulders by walking the hands out to a plank.

safetyNotes: Bend your knees as needed; skip with wrist or shoulder pain.
